questions.prompt: A system with one general-purpose CPU and a disk controller that has its own microprocessor is a multiprocessor system.
Multiprocessor systems are also known as:
A system has 8 processors. What speedup should you expect over 1 processor?
options: Less than 8×, because of overhead and competition for shared resources

questions.prompt: Multiprocessors can cost less than several single-processor machines because they share peripherals, storage, and power. What's that advantage called? (three words)
One of 10 CPUs fails, and the system keeps running at about 90% speed. What is that called?

options: The system shuts down safely after a failure
The system can survive any single component failure and keep operating as if nothing happened
The user is told to fix the hardware

questions.prompt: Which of the three advantages means more work done in less time? (two words)
Nearly every modern phone, laptop, and server is a multiprocessor system.
